name: Ryouri
source:
Man wakes up in a white room. Hands are tied. His wife, with whom he lives separately, stands in front of him. She wants him to eat her home cooking. Why grotesque horror images come to his mind?

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男人在一间白色房间醒来，双手被绑住。与他分居的妻子站在面前。她想让他吃自己做的家常菜。为什么他的脑海中会浮现出怪诞的恐怖画面？

[改自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
